value.rationale: This is the complete intrinsic p-rank/a-number stratification of a natural one-dimensional cyclic-order-eight genus-six moduli locus in the first prime admitted by the motivating paper. The two isolated nonordinary classes have distinct rank pairs (4,2) and (2,4), which cannot be inferred from the known nonsuperspeciality classification. This gives a useful exact small-characteristic benchmark for moduli and p-torsion stratifications, without claiming full Ekedahl--Oort types or arbitrary prime generality.
